# Prompt Challenge Generator

prompt_challenge_generator is a Python CLI that generates prompt engineering challenges with injection-resistant test cases and promptfoo assets for prompt engineers.

## Canonical pages

- Repository: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator
- README: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/README.md
- Entry point: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/main.py
- Arguments: https://github.com/mikaeltorni/prompt_challenge_generator/blob/master/src/Args.py
- Promptfoo: https://www.promptfoo.dev/
- Related challenge site: https://lunaprompts.com/challenges

## Installation and quickstart

```bash
uv sync --locked
uv run main.py --help
```

For generation, set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` and pass a non-empty `--theme`.

## Scope

The CLI runs a two-agent OpenRouter pipeline, persists problem statements,
examples, parameters, and test cases, then writes promptfoo evaluation assets.
It is an evaluation-asset generator, not a hosted model or promptfoo service.
